sentences.text:
Through: Mr. Sanjeev Sabhar  State.
 SI Ruby, PS Nangl  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMIT SHARMA  OR % 18.10.2023 CRL.M.A. 28551/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.

3. The present petition under Section 482 of the CrPC seeks quashing of FIR No. 784/2019, under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Nangloi and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending before the court of competent jurisdiction.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file a status report.
Let the same be done before the next date of hearing.
6. Issue notice to Respondent no. 2, to be served through the SHO concerned, for the next date of hearing.
